## Impact

Environment, affected users/operations, severity, start/end (UTC).

## Timeline

Time | Observation/action | Evidence
--- | --- | ---

## Diagnosis and recovery

First failing boundary, tested hypotheses, cause, contributing factors, mitigation,
recovery verification and measured timings. Redact credentials and customer data.

## Follow-up

Action, owner, due date and success criterion. Separate observed facts from hypotheses.
